text:
# SEO and GEO audit: Brightside Dental (Eleventy site, 5 pages)

I read every tracked file. Findings are ordered by severity.

## Critical

1. **`src/_includes/base.njk:8` – canonical points at the staging host.**
   - Every page declares `https://staging.brightside-dental.example…` as canonical. The sitemap and robots.txt use `www.brightside-dental.example`.
   - Search engines and AI crawlers are told the real pages are duplicates of a staging site.
   - Fix: use the production origin. `geo.config.json:1` already defines it, so expose it as Eleventy global data (e.g. `src/_data/site.js` or `site.json`) and write `href="{{ site.origin }}{{ page.url }}"`.

2. **`src/services.njk:5` – `noindex: true` on the Services page.**
   - This is your main commercial page. It is also listed in `src/sitemap.xml:4`, which sends contradictory signals.
   - Fix: delete the line. Keep `noindex` on `src/thanks.njk:5`, which is correct.

## High

3. **`src/contact.njk:10` – JSON-LD is invalid.**
   - The trailing comma after `"telephone"` makes the block fail to parse, so no structured data is read.
   - Fix: remove the comma. Then extend the Dentist schema with `url`, `address` (PostalAddress: 12 Park Row, Leeds, plus postcode), `openingHours`, `image` and `priceRange`. Add `sameAs` links if you have profiles.
   - Also add `Organization`/`WebSite` schema in `base.njk`, and `Person` schema for dentists on the team page.

4. **`src/contact.njk:8` – `data-nosnippet` on the insurance line.**
   - It hides that text from search snippets and AI answers. Remove it unless you want that text excluded on purpose. Insurance is a common patient question.

5. **`src/team.njk:1-4` – missing `description`.**
   - `base.njk:7` renders `content=""`, so there is an empty meta description. Add one. Also guard the tag in the template with `{% if description %}`.

6. **Thin, unsupported content, which hurts both SEO and AI citation.**
   - `src/team.njk:6` – "decades of experience" with no names, GDC numbers, qualifications or photos. AI engines cite named, verifiable people.
   - `src/services.njk:8-9` – a bare list of four items. The text "Our prices are simple and clear" shows no prices. Give each service its own section or page with what it is, who it's for, cost and FAQs.
   - `src/index.njk:7` – "Trusted by thousands" has no proof. Add reviews, a rating or credentials.
   - Fix: write concrete, quotable facts, and add FAQ content with `FAQPage` markup.

## Medium

7. **`src/_includes/base.njk:2` – `<html>` has no `lang`.** Use `<html lang="en-GB">`.

8. **`src/_includes/base.njk:4-9` – no social or sharing tags.**
   - Add `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image`, `og:type` and `twitter:card`.

9. **`src/index.njk:8` – `/img/reception.jpg` is not in the repo.**
   - No `src/img/` directory exists, and there is no passthrough copy in `.eleventy.js:1`. The image will 404.
   - Fix: add the file and `config.addPassthroughCopy('src/img')`. Also add `width`, `height` and `loading` attributes.

10. **`src/sitemap.xml` is a hand-written static file.**
    - It has no `<lastmod>`, and it will drift from the real pages. Here it already lists the noindexed Services page.
    - Fix: generate it from `collections.all`, excluding `noindex` pages.

11. **`geo.config.json:1` – `aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"` is not reflected in `src/robots.txt`.**
    - `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /` does allow everything today, so the policy is met in effect. But nothing enforces it.
    - Fix: add explicit groups for the AI search bots you want: `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `Google-Extended`. If you ever add a restrictive rule under `*`, explicit groups keep these bots allowed.

## Low / suggestions

12. **`src/_includes/base.njk` – no `llms.txt`.** Optional, but cheap. Add a short summary of the practice, services and key pages.
13. **Titles in `src/index.njk:3`, `src/team.njk:3`, `src/contact.njk:3`.** "Contact | Brightside Dental" and "Thanks | …" are weak. Include the location and intent, e.g. "Contact Brightside Dental – Park Row, Leeds".
14. **`src/_includes/base.njk:12` – no header, footer or NAP.** Put the name, address and phone in a footer on every page for local SEO. Add `<header>` and `<footer>` landmarks.
15. **Heading content.** The h1s are fine and unique. Add h2s as the pages grow.

## Suggested fix order
1. Items 1 and 2: canonical and noindex. These are the biggest wins.
2. Item 3: the JSON-LD comma.
3. Items 4, 5 and 7.
4. Item 6: the content, which does the most for AI visibility.
5. The rest.

I haven't changed any files. I can apply items 1–5, 7–9 and 11 now if you want. The content work in item 6 needs real facts from you: dentist names and qualifications, prices, and reviews.
